steps.text: Give the letter to the captain in the middle of Humberton.

steps.loc_note: guard by the drawbridge in Cotswold
steps.text: Find Cemmeth Budgwold at the Cotswold drawbridge.
Bring Cemmeth three river sprite toes, one at a time.

notes: 'Traveler's Way' quests were added in patch 1.48 (period). River sprites, not spritelings.

name: Traveler's Way -- Dwarf Raid

steps.loc_note: guard tower west of the church, southwest of Humberton
steps.text: Locate Lieutenant Jursen at the guard tower southwest of Humberton.
Kill two dwarf raiders.
Report back to Lieutenant Jursen.

steps.loc_note: Humberton
steps.text: Hand the recommendation to Captain Ryder in Humberton.

notes: Dwarf raiders appear when Jursen gives the quest (event spawn).

name: Traveler's Way -- Supply Run (version 1)

steps.text: Collect the supplies from the merchant.

steps.loc_note: bridge near Prydwen Keep; escorts you to the outpost and back
steps.text: Meet Lady Aelawen at the bridge near Prydwen Keep.

steps.loc_note: outpost near the Salisbury Plains bridge
steps.text: Deliver the supplies to Commander Blaen.

notes: Version 1 of 2 (the server picks one; version 2 below is the Humberton/Swanton variant). Escort by Lady Aelawen = scripted follow; can be a simple talk step.

name: Traveler's Way -- Supply Run (version 2)

steps.loc_note: hut in Humberton
steps.text: Collect supplies from the merchant Bline in Humberton.

steps.loc_note: smith at Snowdonia Station
steps.text: Talk to the smith Thol Dunnin at Snowdonia Station.

steps.loc_note: Swanton Keep
steps.text: Deliver the supplies to Ley Manton at Swanton Keep.

notes: Generate only one of the two Supply Run versions (v2 has all NPCs named).

name: Wisdom

giver.name: Trainer
giver.loc_note: Master Grundelth (Wizard), Magus Cormac (Sorcerer), Master Dubri (Minstrel)

steps.loc_note: guard tower past Cotswold toward Prydwen Keep
steps.text: Show the book to Sage Nelson in the Camelot Hills tower.

steps.loc_note: guard tower just south of Ludlow
steps.text: Show the book to Sage Lissa south of Ludlow.

steps.loc_note: guard tower on the far side of the bridge north of Ludlow
steps.text: Show the book to Sage Crystal and solve her riddle.
Return to your trainer at the Academy.

notes: One of three riddles at random; answers books, stars, shoe (riddle texts not on the page).

name: Wizard Lost

steps.loc_note: Lethantis Association behind Campacorentin Station
steps.text: Ask Olorustos at the Lethantis Association about Merlin.

steps.loc_note: Adribard's Retreat
steps.text: Talk to Scribe Eril at Adribard's Retreat.

steps.loc_note: Snowdonia border keep
steps.text: Talk to Cynwik the Wizard at the Snowdonia border keep.
Return to Olorustos.

steps.loc_note: Merlin's Tower
steps.text: Ask Magess Islia about Merlin being on another plane.

steps.loc_note: pre-1.76 location unknown (1.76 put her in Salisbury Plains at night, 21736,45480)
steps.text: Slay the Green Witch and take the wizard-locked box.
Return the box to Magess Islia.
Return to Lady Nimue.

notes: Rewards listed are the Legend of the Lake (15) ones paid by Nimue; this subquest pays XP. Green Witch pre-1.76 location: check server spawns/CapnBry.

name: Chains of Death

steps.loc_note: second floor of the Academy
steps.text: Ask Loremaster Alain about the bone figurine.
Return to your trainer, who gives you a second, blessed figurine as a gift.

steps.loc_note: Adribard's Retreat (or Lady Lynn)
steps.text: Ask the church trainers at Adribard's Retreat what they know.

steps.loc_note: ruined Roman villa west along the road from Cornwall Station (pre-1.75); giant skeletons around
steps.then: the blessed gift destroys her; remaining giant skeletons attack; drops Netherworldly Cloak
steps.text: Find the woman who roams among the undead in Cornwall and present the figurine and the gift.
Return to your trainer.

notes: 1.75 moved Erich northeast of Cornwall Station (61.1k,14.8k); 1.65 = Roman villa west on the road. Erich also drops Netherworldly Cloak.

name: Heart of Albion

steps.loc_note: Adribard's Retreat
steps.text: Decipher the poem and speak to the right person at Adribard's Retreat.

steps.loc_note: ruined church south of Adribard's Retreat; kill the Bishop first
steps.text: Destroy the Undead Knight Fiedel at the ruined church.
Return the shard of knowledge to Summer Gram.

steps.loc_note: instrument merchant in the loft of the West Downs barn
steps.text: Speak to Marlin Thuler at West Downs.
Slay Slave Master Cottrel.
Bring Cottrel's broken sword to Marlin Thuler.
Give Lady Nimue the shard of freedom.
Gather mud from a mud golem.

steps.loc_note: northwest of Caer Witrin
steps.text: Gather mist from the mist monster.
Give the mud and mist to Lady Nimue and answer her question.

notes: Herald quest contest 2002 (period). Open to all classes.

name: Traveler's Way -- Stones of Power (version 1)

steps.loc_note: Cotswold
steps.text: Chat with Lundeg Tranyth in Cotswold.

steps.loc_note: under the boar markings on the hillside, right after the double bridge near Ludlow
steps.text: Find a hidden eye on the giant spiders under the boar markings.
Return the eye to Lundeg Tranyth.

notes: Generate one of the two Stones of Power versions per character (the server can pick v1 or v2 at random like live). Wizards/Sorcerers keep the Hidden Eye as their reward.

name: Traveler's Way -- Stones of Power (version 2)

steps.loc_note: possibly Bline
steps.text: Speak to the merchant in Humberton village.

steps.loc_note: between the standing and broken towers of the demon tower, east of the Camelot Hills-Salisbury bridge southeast of Prydwen Keep
steps.text: Slay the weakened demon behind the demon's tower.
Turn in the demon soul gem in Humberton.

notes: Humberton merchant probably Bline (v1 mentions Bline as an alternative).

name: Immediate Resolution
offer: Your services are needed now! Will you assist your trainer with a vital mission?

steps.text: Speak to Olorustos. He will instruct you further.
Locate Guardian Aron, who defends a point just southwest of the Lethantis Association, and deliver the wax-sealed note. Do not tarry!

notes: Second version of the server's Immediate Resolution script (ImmediateResolutionVB, Black Mtns. South). On finish Guardian Aron calls the guards and blue-con robbers attack (event spawn of 'Robber' near Aron, guards fight them).

name: Cellar Infestation
offer: Ylaine Barrett's food cellar has been swarming with swamp goo. Will you aid her in ridding the cellars of swamp goo?

steps.text: Speak to Ylaine Barrett in Gothwaite Harbor about the swamp goo in the cellar.
Hunt the swamp goo in the water just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite and return a skin to Ylaine.
Return the skin to Ylaine Barrett.

name: Inconnu Poison
offer: Trynt Madoc wants to prove to the people of the Isle of Glass that the Inconnu are allies. Will you help Trynt Madoc and his group?

steps.text: Speak with Trynt Madoc in the gazebo in Gothwaite Harbor.
Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor.
Take the sea pup fin to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor.
Go to Burton MacDougal, the poison merchant, and give him the poison prepared by Lirele.
Give Lirele's scroll to Burton MacDougal.

name: Commencement
offer: The roads are dangerous these days and to survive you will require companions. Seek out the local crier and gain insight into grouping.

steps.text: Seek out Barnarn the crier in Humberton.
Form a group with a fellow member of this realm.
Return to Barnarn the crier while grouped.

notes: Walkthrough stops after the group instruction; reward unknown (auto). 'group' step = player must be in a group (companion bots count) when talking to the crier.

name: Flint Weapons
offer: Stone weapons, if made correctly, can be quite effective. I can make a [knife], a [club], or a [dirk].

steps.text: Bring a chert to the stonemason and he will make you a weapon.
steps.from_source: A29: "Cherts drop from multiple low level mobs"; Related NPCs: River Spriteling

collect.from: low level monsters in the zone

notes: Not a journal quest: a repeatable chert-for-weapon trade at several stonemasons. Cherts drop from many low level monsters; the drop list must be chosen from level 1-5 monsters near each stonemason.

name: Lost Potion
offer: Sister Genette Ashlan dislikes the Inconnu. Speak to Genette and tell her Trynt sent you.

steps.text: Speak with Sister Genette Ashlan in Caer Gothwaite. Tell her [Trynt sent] you.
Seek out the damp skeletons north-northeast of Caer Gothwaite and get two bones for Lirele.
Give Lirele the two damp skeleton bones in Gothwaite Harbor.
Give Sister Genette Ashlan the potion prepared by Lirele.

name: Disturbing Illness
offer: The healer Genette is treating a new illness that seems to affect only the Inconnu. Will you aid the healer to find a cure?

steps.text: Talk to Sister Genette Ashlan, the healer by the bind stone in Caer Gothwaite, about the Inconnu sickness.
Bring Sister Genette the skin of a sea pup from the water west of Caer Gothwaite.
Return to Sister Genette with the skin.
Tell Tage, Dalvay's acolyte at the three stones in Caer Gothwaite, that Sister Genette is ready for the next portion of the remedy.
Bring Tage a swamp goo from the water just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite.
Return the swamp goo to Tage.
Take the pulpy mixture to Sister Genette.

notes: The first ingredient was random in the period game (sea pup skin, large dragonfly poison sac, or urchin quib quills); the spec uses the sea pup skin.

name: Association
offer: Locate Hunter Ceron on the ridge north of Ludlow; he has word for you.

steps.text: Locate and speak to Hunter Ceron on a ridge just north of Ludlow.
Deliver the note to the crier in front of the tavern in Ludlow.
Deliver the note to Commander Buin at the tower just east of Ludlow.
Return to your trainer.

notes: One version; another sent the note to Cemmeth in Cotswold instead of Commander Buin.

name: Nain Hunting
offer: Hunt the Nain dwarves on the hill south of the castle and bring back proof.

steps.text: Kill Nain dwarves south of the castle toward the Abbey and bring back proof for a minor reward.
steps.from_source: A31: "Kill them [Nain Dwarves] and bring back proof"

notes: Turn-in task, not a journal quest. Drop item name not recorded; server monster name for the Nain dwarves to be resolved (nain / nain dwarf).

name: Rock Imps
offer: Imps on the hill behind me are pushing boulders down on the town! Bring me evidence that you have killed them and you will be handsomely rewarded.

steps.text: Kill the rock imps on the ridge due north of Ludlow, west of the road to the bridge, and bring Crep Pew their parts.
steps.from_source: A4: "for every part"; Related NPCs: Rock Imp

notes: Each imp part is exchanged for a yellow quartz gem, which Crep Pew buys back for 160 copper.

name: Soul Hunt
offer: One of Arawn's souls instigated the swamp goo infestation and the Inconnu sickness. Speak to Tage, he'll fill you in.

steps.text: Speak to Tage.
Seek out Jocias among the damp skeletons and retrieve his soul.
Jocias fled into a damp skeleton. Find and retrieve Jocias' soul from the damp skeleton it fled to.
Return the soul to Tage.

notes: Jocias appeared near 46k-49k,49k-51k among the damp skeletons after many were killed: event spawn for the questing player near the damp skeletons.

name: Souls of the Dead
offer: A group wants those of the Temple of Arawn to leave. Speak to Trynt Madoc about the people speaking out against the Inconnu.

steps.text: Speak with Trynt Madoc in Gothwaite Harbor about the group of people against the Inconnu.
Go speak with Tessa Ohrman in Gothwaite Harbor.
Get the souls of three headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor.
Turn in the three souls to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor.

notes: Each headless dead kill gives a soul (quest item). Walkthrough truncated before the reward.

name: Guild Introduction (Disciple)
offer: You are destined for service as a necromancer in the Temple of Arawn. Speak to Carys to learn about the role of Necromancers.

steps.text: Speak to Carys, the Necromancer trainer.

name: Guild Introduction (Rogue)
offer: Soon you must choose which profession to follow. Speak to Lieutenant Newster about the Scouts of the Defenders of Albion.

steps.text: Speak to Lieutenant Newster about life as a Scout and the Defenders of Albion.
Speak with Elaru about life as an Infiltrator and the Guild of Shadows.

name: Guild Preparation
offer: It is time for you to make yourself known to the guilds in this realm. There are but four guilds in Albion: the Church of Albion, the Defenders of Albion, the Academy and the Guild of Shadows.

steps.text: Seek out a future guild trainer. Do not join a guild at this time or you will fail this quest!
Seek out another guild trainer.
Return to your original trainer.

notes: Any two advanced-class trainers in Humberton count; the quest fails if the player picks a class (the generator abandons it on class change).

name: Zombie Problem
offer: Help! An army of zombie swine has invaded my farm. Only at night do the beasts rise from the grave to ravage my fields.

steps.text: Kill the zombie sows at Gronyr's farm by night and give him their hog tails.
steps.from_source: A15: "Killing the zombie sows will sometimes get you a rotting hog tail"

notes: Gronyr wanders between Prydwen Keep, the Camelot road stone and the farm by the stables; zombie sows spawn only at night.

name: Bandit Ears
offer: I am offering a reward for the ears of any bandits you kill.

steps.text: Bring Hunter Derwyn, at the bandit tower, the ear of a bandit.
steps.from_source: A10: "a reward for the ears of any bandits you kill" (Bandit Highwaymen in Constantine's Sound are post-period)

steps.text: Take the writ of bounty to Sir Dorian in the tower.

notes: Turn-in chain. Bandit highwaymen in Constantine's Sound also drop ears.

name: Cleric Mulgrut
offer: Lord Prydwen once had a faithful cleric, Mulgrut, who turned from God after his son died. Even in death his soul never rests, and it is said he carried an item of great worth into the afterlife.

steps.text: Locate and slay Mulgrut Maggot west of Prydwen Keep for his magical item. He walks with two decayed zombies and a putrid zombie between the cemetery and the hill with the tall stone.

name: Ripper
offer: Ever heard of Throatripper? An angry wolf that attacked one of our patrols. I cannot leave my post. Will you [kill it]?

steps.text: Find and slay Throatripper near the edge of the forest between the cutpurse and dwarf camps.
Return to Lieutenant Jursen for your reward.
Travel to Ludlow and show Seamstress Marie the ripper pelt.
Kill large skeletons near Cotswold and Prydwen Keep until you get a polished bone.
Give Seamstress Marie the polished bone.

notes: Throatripper appeared after a wolf at the forest edge was killed, then ran; event spawn for the questing player.

name: Simple Request
offer: I need someone to perform a simple errand: take this sealed note to Lieutenant Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.

steps.text: Take the sealed note to Lieutenant Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.
Return the reply to Lieutenant Brude at Snowdonia Fortress.

notes: Courier job: notes back and forth; walkthrough gives no details beyond that. Reply item name invented as a plain quest item.

name: Camdene's Components
offer: I need three components to make some special dyes, and I will reward you if you collect them for me.

steps.text: Get a rat tongue from a swamp rat.
Get a worm rot from a rot worm.
Get bog mud from a bogman grappler.
Return to Dyemaster Camdene in Adribard's Retreat and speak to him.
Give him the components one at a time, in order.

rewards.xp: almost a blue bubble at level 6

notes: Reward bottle is a light green dye ('a bottle of light gre...' in the walkthrough); confirm the item name from item pass 2.

name: Goblin Incursion
offer: We have a goblin problem and are awaiting news from a scout. Run to Commander Jusen past the second marker beyond the bridge toward Snowdonia Station.

steps.text: Find Commander Jusen past the second marker beyond the bridge toward Snowdonia Station.
Hand the note back to Guard Reed in Humberton.
Go to the goblin camp north of Humberton and kill its leaders, Grilo and Fusnup.
Kill Fusnup.
Return to Guard Reed.
Warn Guy Reed, the guard's son, in Ludlow that the goblins will attack.
Talk to Maggie McClellan.

notes: Choice of four bracelets (strength, intelligence, piety or dexterity). Also offered through the Ludlow crier and Camelot barkeep.

name: Heart of Sephucoth
offer: I can fashion pendants of intricate beauty and make them talismans of power, but the centerpiece must be the heart of a terrible beast and the set piece a polished bone.

steps.text: Collect the heart of Sephucoth, who appears among the river sprites by the sunken ship south of Cotswold.
Collect a polished bone from the large skeletons.
Return the reagents to Elvar Ironhand in Cotswold.

name: Hunt for Slith
offer: Some talk of a red snake that will only come should he become displeased. This rare snake was last seen to the east, not far from the walls of Camelot.

steps.text: Locate and kill Slith northeast of the gates of Camelot; kill the broodlings to flush him out.
Bring Slith's tail to Commander Burcrif.

notes: Old walkthrough finishes on Slith's death; the newer dialog returns to Burcrif. Spec returns to Burcrif so the reward is handed over.

name: Search for Sil
offer: Sil has gone missing. Will you find him for me?

steps.text: Ask Sir Dorian at the tower by the Cotswold bindstone if he has seen Sil.
Sil was killed by the spriggarn Ygwrch Gyrg on the hill with the stone head statue. Kill things on the hill until Ygwrch appears.
Return to Nob and tell him of Sil's fate.

name: Sunken Cargo
offer: My boat has sunk in the river and my cargo of fine apple brandy for the King's table is lost!

steps.text: Follow the river south from Cotswold to the sunken ship surrounded by river sprites; kill them until Sephucoth appears.
Bring the brandy back to Cullen Smyth in Cotswold.

notes: Shares Sephucoth with Heart of Sephucoth. The gold nugget is a vendor-sell item.

name: Father Hugrath
offer: My dad went into the ruin nearby and never came back. I fear he may be dead.

steps.text: Find Hugrath, undead and surrounded by friends, in the smaller broken tower southeast of the Demon Tower, upriver from Frip's bridge.
Let Frip know about his dad.

name: Lady Leana
offer: Nob the Stableboy has a problem with faeries. Go talk to him.

steps.text: Talk to Nob the Stableboy about the faeries terrorizing his animals.
Find Lady Leana at the pond in the nearby weeping willow grove and talk to her. Do not kill her faeries first.
There is no peaceful solution: slay Lady Leana.

notes: Killing her faeries before talking to her failed the quest in the period game.

name: Protecting Anniogel
offer: Lady Treva has asked me to make a potion to protect Anniogel. Will you gather the components for Kaere's spell to protect Anniogel?

steps.text: Capture a draft of water from a lesser water elemental with Kaere's vial.
Take the glowing spirit stone from one of the ghosts that roam the land.
Get the tail of a giant dragonfly.
Get the dirt from an urchin rabblerouser.
Bring the components to Kaere in Anniogel.
Use the potion in Anniogel to protect the town.
Return to Kaere.

notes: Reward list from the walkthrough; Theurgist and Cabalist assumed to share the Wizard staff (not listed). The Heretic reward (Malcontent's Pants) is post-1.65 and is not used. Collect item names partly reconstructed from Kaere's dialog.

name: Dunan's Bear Tooth
offer: Gundron McCory and the Black Mountain Blades attacked me and stole an unfinished charm made from a rare bear tooth. Should he meet his death, I would complete the charm and pass it to you.

steps.text: Search the area around Ludlow for the Black Mountain Blades leader, Gundron McCory. He is rarely alone!
Return the bear tooth to Apprentice Dunan in Ludlow.

notes: The older version rewarded a Beartooth Charm; the pendant choice is the version with full dialog.

name: Price of Courage
offer: Young Trini Piper lost her parents to the goblins at an early age. Talk to her.

steps.text: Talk to Trini Piper.
Talk to Jezzy Piper, who raised Trini.
Slay Grilk's goblin servant the ratmaker, south of Tepok's Mine.
Slay the footscratcher.
Slay the bonescraper.
Take the three goblin heads to Commander Jusen in the tower due east of the mine.
Take the King's token to Trini.
Talk to Jezzy Piper.
Return to Maggie McClellan at the Ludlow tavern.

name: Thinking Cap
offer: My cousin Bouditha is abusing a family cap. Get it back from her!

steps.text: Find Bouditha atop the hill across from Ludlow and take back the cap.
Return the cap to Cranly at Snowdonia Station.

notes: Cranly stands outside near the Snowdonia Station bindstone. Whether Bouditha is fought or talked to is not recorded; spec kills her.

name: Departed Hero
offer: Morgana has raised the knight Sir Gerenth from the dead and left him in the hands of druids in a cemetery in the North Black Mountains. Put him to rest and bring back his bone dagger.

steps.text: Put Sir Gerenth to rest in the cemetery southeast of the goblin camp near Snowdonia Station.
Return the bone dagger to Lieutenant Brude.

name: Dragon Ant Charm
offer: I can make a new charm for you, but I need a dragon ant larva to do it.

steps.text: Kill ants on the hill northwest of Snowdonia Station until the dragon ant queen appears, and take her spotted larva.
Bring the spotted larva to Ember at the back of the Snowdonia Station inn.

notes: The queen also spawned in the Camelot Hills bandit fields near Fortress Sauvage (33k,27k). Regular ants drop a plain dragon ant larva, which is NOT accepted.

name: Intervention
offer: Take this document to Brother Don at the Abbey in the southern Black Mountains.

steps.text: Take the document to Brother Don at Vetusta Abbey in the southern Black Mountains.
Return the wax-sealed note to Sir Defi.

name: Tale of Druids
offer: Have you not seen the druids encroaching into our area? Master Kless has studied the druids at much length. Ask him of the [druids].

steps.text: Speak to Master Kless in the last house on the right in Cotswold. Ask him of [druids].
Travel NNE from the twin towers at the north end of the double bridge to the druid circle on the North/South Black Mountains border and slay a filidh sacrificer.
Return the filidh's dagger to Master Kless at Cotswold.
Speak with Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage. Ask him of [druids].
Speak with Ornis inside Swanton Keep.
Seek out Librarian Pelan upstairs in the Academy in Camelot. Ask him of [standing stones].
Take the book to Master Kless in Cotswold.

notes: Walkthrough lists no ring for Wizard, Mercenary or Cleric; they are given the ring of the closest listed group. Swanton Keep zone to confirm.

name: Cloak of Shades
offer: Meran the Weaver in Prydwen Keep can make a Cloak of Shades, if you gather what she needs.

steps.text: Talk to Meran the Weaver along the back wall of Prydwen Keep.
Kill a red adder in Salisbury Plains for its glowing snake skin.
Kill a will o' wisp east of Caer Ulfwych in Campacorentin Forest.
Return the components to Meran the Weaver.
Find Dyemaster Thrurin, who wanders the woods along the road between Camelot and Ludlow.
Kill a dryad in the woods around Snowdonia Station for a container.
Return the container to Thrurin; he lost the dye to a thief.
Kill the red dwarf chief in the valley below the bull carved into the hill, east of the double bridge, and recover the horn of drinking.
Return the horn to Thrurin.
Kill the bandit Aldous Wynedd on top of the hill east of Ludlow and recover the dye.
Return the dye to Thrurin.
Get black rocks from a boulderling in Camelot Hills.
Return the black rocks to Thrurin.
Give Meran the components to receive the Cloak of Shades.

notes: Pre-1.82 version (Campacorentin wisps). Period variations: wild boar hide / brownie nomad sinew instead of adder/wisp; gray warg or black dog in some steps. Item names for wisp essence, container, stolen dye and shadow dye are not recorded.

name: Niea's Missing Brother
offer: Gwulin has information about my brother's disappearance and may need coercion. Take this pack of money and find him.

steps.text: Find Gwulin on the road from the Camelot Hills bridge toward Salisbury Plains and give him the pouch of money.
Gwulin attacks! Slay him.
Take the flute to Andryn the stableboy at West Downs.

notes: Gwulin becomes aggressive to the player on the pouch hand-in (quest hook).

name: Sals' Jar
offer: Aldous Wynedd stole the jar I was going to use to enter the Potter's Guild. I want it back.

steps.text: Kill Aldous Wynedd on top of the hill north of Ludlow.
Return the jar to Sals Pew in Ludlow.

name: Sir Gleran's Lost Necklace
offer: Complete the quest Roan had undertaken, if only to clear his name: retrieve the necklace he was to deliver.

steps.text: Kill the filidh leader Kedalinde Teanidd in the small valley behind West Downs.
Give the necklace to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.

name: Staff of Life
offer: Slay the filidh Aithne Con to the south. She is dangerous; bring a friend.

steps.text: Cross the river, head south, then due east to the stone ring on a hillside, where Aithne Con spawns.
Take her head back to Llewellyn Camber by the water south of Prydwen Keep.

name: Tainted Magic
offer: Yasminea Dardin has had trouble casting magic on her pet Pebbles, but Bouncer Corwin won't let anyone near her.

steps.text: Get three ales from the Ludlow bartender.
Give the ales to Bouncer Corwin; he starts crooning a love song to Yasminea.
Talk with Yasminea Dardin.
Get the pouch of a goblin shaman from the camp near Tepok's Mine.
Bring the pouch to Keenar Woedin in the Ludlow tavern.
Kill The Great Gobzini, performing just north of Tepok's Mine.
Bring the magical bag back to Yasminea.
Talk to Corwin, who offers [Gloves], [Sleeves] or [Boots].

notes: Other classes take the closest set (Theurgist/Cabalist/Sorcerer: Secret; Armsman/Mercenary/Reaver: Legerdemain; Infiltrator: Dextrous) - walkthrough lists only six classes. The follow-up whisper [Elope] to Maggie gave about 16-32k xp.

name: Bandit Camp
offer: Cleddyf and Cilydd Difwych feud from their camps east of the road to Forest Sauvage. A messenger runs between them; take his place and intercept the messages.

steps.text: Find and kill the messenger on the dirt hill behind the bandit tower.
Wear the bandit tunic and deliver the note to Cleddyf.
Deliver the sealed note to Sir Kenley (take off the tunic first).
Wait for midnight, when Cleddyf leaves his camp for the meeting point with a bandit lieutenant, and kill him.
Deliver Cleddyf's head to Sir Kenley.

notes: The Bandit Tunic makes bandits neutral while worn (quest item effect; generator may skip the disguise and rely on the kill). Cleddyf walks at night only; the generator can spawn him at the meeting point for the questing player at any hour.

name: Guarding the Stone
offer: My squire Graid guards a stone in Salisbury Plains and has not reported. Find him.

steps.text: Find Squire Graid at the large rock in Salisbury Plains and talk to him.
Deal with the Ghostwalker's Apprentice and the undead that accompany him.
Hand Squire Graid the apprentice's pack.
Return to Sir Jerem in Prydwen Keep and give him the pack.

notes: The squire's horse Abagu stands with him. The apprentice approached the stone from the east around midnight; event spawn near the stone for the questing player.

name: Information / Trickery
offer: Three Drakoran border watchers each carry a scroll with information I want. And one of the ladies here needs the essence of a corpse candle.

steps.text: Kill three Drakoran border watchers by the trees past the farthest fort southwest of Anniogel.
Kill a corpse candle in the trees directly south of Anniogel for its essence.
Return to General Wystan in Caer Gothwaite.

branch.name: Trickery
branch.text: Dory offers a bribe: give him the scrolls and take his fake scrolls to the General instead.

notes: The reward is a token taken to Armorer Gamila, who gives the class boots. Cleric and Minstrel boots are cut off in the walkthrough (item pass 2). Sodden corpses north of Anniogel (42.7k,7.5k) are listed as related.

name: Barnett's Shield
offer: My best man Barnett was ambushed and killed defending my Lady's honor. Find both halves of his shield and bring me the head of Mootang, who is responsible.

steps.text: Get the two shield halves from boulderlings high on the mountainside behind Swanton Keep.
Kill Mootang in the back left hut of the goblin camp near Swanton Keep.
Return the shield halves and Mootang's head to Sir Gleran in the order he requests.

notes: Max level 25 is from patch 1.70; the period maximum is unknown (kept 25). Sir Gleran also hands a bag for Bedelia (Bedelia's Grief).

name: Growler's Necklace
offer: Sub-quest of The Growling Ghost: bring Growler his necklace and free his bones.

steps.text: Kill the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych at his camp on the road to Castle Sauvage.
Return the necklace to Growler.
Free his bones: slay Growler.

notes: Part of The Growling Ghost (A335); spec it together with that quest if the generator merges them.

name: Lady Judith's Circlet
offer: Lady Judith's gold and pearl circlet has been stolen, but she recognized the robber. Get it back.

steps.text: Kill the bandit Cyfer Difwych in the central camp due east of the east Camelot gates.
Return the opal to Gaevin Sebryn.
Cyfer traded the circlet to the demon Fielath for a spell. Seek him out in the broken tower in the undead ruins by the river.
Return to Gaevin for your reward.

notes: Period variations: the circlet holder was Aonghas Prirerd (Campacorentin 46.8k,55.5k), Shale the boulderling, Fielath, or Ciraron Webweaver (bloated spiders east of Caer Ulfwych). Spec uses Fielath.

name: Slythcur Cloak
offer: Collect a pile of drake scales and a brown drake eye from the carrion drakes, then the hide of the drake Slythcur, and I will make you a cloak.

steps.text: Collect a pile of drake scales from the carrion drakes in Salisbury Plains.
Collect a brown drake eye from the carrion drakes.
Kill Slythcur, a named drake, for its hide.
Return to Anga Weaver in Adribard's Retreat and give her the parts in order.

name: The Captured Courier
offer: Find Dustan and help him deliver a box. He was ambushed in Camelot Hills.

steps.text: At the bandit camp near the Tomb of Mithra, find Cilydd Difwych and kill him for the box.
Kill the druid Zelsania Nodith, who holds Dustan hostage just west of the circle of stones in northwest Salisbury Plains.
Talk with Dustan and give him the key and box.
Head to Adribard's Retreat and give Brother Onoloth the pendant.

notes: Dustan is a hostage NPC beside Zelsania Nodith (event spawn when missing).

name: The Growling Ghost
offer: A growling ghost haunts the plains. Speak with Growler, and see that he is put to rest.

steps.text: Speak with Growler near the northwest guard tower of Salisbury Plains.
Kill the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych on the road to Castle Sauvage for Growler's necklace.
Return the necklace to Growler.
Free his bones: slay Growler.
Return proof of Growler's rest to Sergeant Alain on the south side of the Camelot Hills bridge.

notes: Merged with Growler's Necklace (A135). Growler's pre-1.75 location is not recorded; the 1.75 spot near the northwest guard tower is used.

name: Drakoran Watchers
offer: A Drakoran scout has been spotted a little too close to Gothwaite. Speak to Ely in Caifelle.

steps.text: Speak to Ely in Caifelle.
Find the wandering Drakoran scout east of Anniogel and northwest of Caifelle.
Read the sealed letter.
Take the sealed letter back to Ely and decide what to do.
Kill the Drakoran leader Ariach.
Take the attack plans to Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor.

notes: Allakhazam's spelling Araich/Ariach. Class mapping for Greaves, Mace and Purged Staff inferred from item types (item pass 2 to confirm). Heretic reward skipped (post-1.65). The 'let the defenders handle it' choice ends the quest early (reward unknown).

name: Reaching Beyond
offer: Take this ticket to West Downs and speak to Larson O'Riley.

steps.text: Speak to Larson O'Riley just west of West Downs.
Get a feather from the named basilisk Tuka on the ridge across the road from West Downs.
Swim at the base of the Prydwen Keep / Salisbury bridge and search for the root.
Give Larson the feather and the root.
Return to Edith Waring and give her the potion.

notes: Introduced the Shrouded Isles (Inconnu appears to Edith). Edith gives a West Downs ticket and 50 silver at the start; Larson gives a ticket back. Reported XP varies (45k at 14).

name: Siom's Staff
offer: Retrieve a sack of red dust from Kedalinde Teanidd, somewhere in Salisbury Plains.

steps.text: Kill Kedalinde Teanidd, leader of the filidhs behind West Downs, for the red dust.
Return the dust to Siom Felanis in Humberton.
Retrieve the backbone of Mystic Ulfwag, leader of the goblin fort northwest of Snowdonia Station.
Return the backbone to Siom Felanis.

notes: One version; steps may vary.

name: Bedelia's Grief
offer: My son Barnett was sent on a mission and killed. I hope to get some of his belongings back. Take this portrait to Sir Gleran to prove I sent you.

steps.text: Give the portrait to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.
Recover both halves of Barnett's shield from the boulderlings behind Swanton Keep (Barnett's Shield).
Kill Mootang at the goblin camp.
Return to Sir Gleran with the shield and Mootang's head.
Return Barnett's shield and sword to Bedelia.
Avenge her son: kill King Smugluk, who ordered Mootang to goad Barnett, at the same goblin camp.
Give King Smugluk's head to Bedelia.

notes: Contains Barnett's Shield; completing either counts the shared steps (the generator lets an active Barnett's Shield satisfy steps 2-4).

name: Willing Sacrifice
offer: Do you attend services regularly? The Cult of Mithra gathers in the tomb. Someone must be willing to sacrifice themselves, and the cult's password must be discovered. Take my journal.

steps.text: Check Brother Codeth's Journal to see what to do now.
The first test of the cultists is given by Anilius. Kill him in the west of the Tomb of Mithra.
Kill Favonius Facilis.
Kill Virilus.
Kill the Forgotten Promise; it tells of the room with the password: west, then north, then west, then north.
Discover the cult password in the room west, north, west, north (the cultists there attack).
Acolyte Naseita must complete the ritual: someone must be willingly slain by him. Then follow the slave.
Follow the slave to High Priest Andania and kill him.
Return to Brother Codeth, give him his journal and tell him the cult's password.

notes: Released Sep 2002. Brother Codeth stands in the guard tower north of the Prydwen Keep bridge. The ritual death step: the player is killed by (or dies near) Acolyte Naseita; a released player may also find the High Priest directly. Generator: spawn High Priest Andania for the questing player once Naseita has killed them (or when the player is in the tomb's lower area on that step).

name: Ivy Weave Gloves
offer: Retrieve the holy book from Brother Jarrel on the ruined bridge in Salisbury Plains. He must be freed from his chains.

steps.text: Free Brother Jarrel from his chains on the ruined bridge east of the Fallen Tower and retrieve the holy book.
Return the holy book to Brother Onoloth in Adribard's Retreat.
Find the first item among the wood ogres southwest of Caer Ulfwych.
Find the second item on an ebony fellwood.
Bring both items to Brother Onoloth.

notes: The two component items are not named in the walkthrough (related monsters: cliff spider, ebony fellwood, shambler, wood ogre seer); names here are placeholders - steps may vary.

name: Contyth's Hammer
offer: Take this letter to Calya in Caer Ulfwych.

steps.text: Deliver the letter to Calya in Caer Ulfwych.
Kill the spirit of Brother Jarrel on the broken bridge east of the Fallen Tower.
Kill Kearcs at the slaver camp in Salisbury Plains.
Return to Calya in Caer Ulfwych for the third item.
Return to Contyth in Humberton and give him the items in order.

notes: Item names for the three components are not given in the walkthrough (placeholders).

name: Kindred of the Fallen
offer: Speak to Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage.

steps.text: Talk to Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage.
Get living tissue from a fellwood; the higher the fellwood's level, the better your chance.
Return the living tissue to Sir Tillian.
Take the box to Aiellana in Adribard's Retreat.
Find the two standing stones of power in Forest Sauvage (southern tip of the river, then southeast).
Return to Aiellana.
Get the wounding stone from a wood ogre at the ogre camp in Campacorentin Forest.
Return with the stone to Aiellana.
Use the wounding stone between the standing stones, closer to the larger one.
Kill the druid summoned by the stone.
Tell Sir Tillian [Evil has been destroyed].
Take Sir Tillian's note to Lieutenant Kuebler.

notes: Stone locs are classic Forest Sauvage (43k,45k); the walkthrough's 20k,16k is the New Frontiers copy. Cabalist/Infiltrator/Friar rewards not listed - closest group used. Urfgrat the Green (south of Caer Ulfwych) was an alternative stone holder.

name: Lord Aryon's Box
offer: Lord Aryon's box holds papers written by him and by King Arthur himself, but the key was stolen from his grave by tomb robbers, and the box is warded.

steps.text: Find Halena Edulan in the tomb robber camp in eastern Salisbury Plains.
Get the scroll that removes the wards from the undead Dread Lord Aryon in the broken church ruins in Avalon Marsh.
Return both the key and the scroll to Sister Elaydith at the Church in Camelot.

notes: Followed by Bishop Burhoff's Curse. Whether Halena and Aryon are fought is implied (key 'in her possession', scroll 'from' Aryon).

name: The Stolen Spells
offer: Some pixies stole three spell scrolls from the Magic Shoppe. Return them.

steps.text: Get the blue spell scroll from the druid Elithralia Nodith next to the entrance to Keltoi Fogou.
Get the green spell scroll from Veviel the grove nymph in Salisbury Plains.
Get the purple spell scroll from the pixie queen south of the road from Caer Ulfwych to Avalon Marsh.
Return the scrolls to Vadri Pade upstairs in the Magic Shoppe.

name: Druid Medicine
offer: My son will die without his medicine, and a druid seer attacked us and stole it.

steps.text: Kill the druid seer in the grove of trees east of the southwest tower, between the two stone rings.
Return the vial to Landon Huntingdon.

notes: Grants no XP (Allakhazam).

name: Bishop Burhoff's Curse
offer: Bishop Burhoff was the most trusted advisor of Lord Aryon. Will you help the Church find out more about Bishop Burhoff? His remains will be the link; you will have to defeat him to get them.

steps.text: Get Bishop Burhoff's skull from the Dark Bishop, who haunts the ruins of Lord Aryon's castle in Avalon Marsh at night.
Return to Brother Lensar in Camelot City.
Find the ghost of Bishop Burhoff in the graveyard behind the Church in Camelot at night and give him the skull.
Talk to Bishop Burhoff and find out about his curse.
Get an adder fang from a forest adder in Forest Sauvage.
Return to Bishop Burhoff in the Camelot graveyard at night and give him the skull and the adder fang.

notes: Before patch 1.76 the Dark Bishop haunted Lord Aryon's ruined castle in Avalon Marsh (Lord Aryon's Box walkthrough); 1.76 moved him behind Vetusta Abbey. Alternate components: large bear eyes or a gwr-drwgiaid eye in Llyn Barfog. The ghost bishop appears only at night (event spawn for the questing player at night).

name: Escaped Bandits
offer: Help Guard Dafydd at the guard tower just outside Campacorentin Forest.

steps.text: Talk to Guard Dafydd at the tower outside Campacorentin Forest about the escaped prisoners.
Find the escaped bandits south of the first druid ring due east of the tower, and slay their leader.
Return the cloak to Guard Dafydd.

name: Goblin Hunting
offer: Bring back the bows of two sylvan goblin hunters and the remains of the boy they took.

steps.text: Kill sylvan goblin hunters on the hill behind Caer Ulfwych for two bows.
Recover the boy's remains from the goblin hunters.
Bring them back to Lenna in Caer Ulfwych.

notes: Levels 22-32 after 1.75b; period range 20-?

name: Oaken Boots
offer: I am an apprentice smith, and I have a tale to tell you of oaken boots.

steps.text: Get oaken bark from an oaken knight west of the road at the forest's northern edge.
Take the bark to Calya's brother Contyth in Humberton.
Get metal shavings from the ghost miners north of Snowdonia Station; they appear at night up the hill past the dragon ants.
See Mathien, their father, at Snowdonia Station.
Take the nails and bark to the guards' armorer in Swanton Keep.

name: The Hunt for Arachneida
offer: Kill the giant spider Arachneida. First you'll need a bloated spider fang.

steps.text: Kill a bloated spider east of Caer Ulfwych for a bloated spider fang.
Kill Arachneida, who spawns with the bloated spiders.
Return to Kealan at Campacorentin Station with the fang and chitin.

notes: 1.75b added a plate reward for Armsmen and Paladins; before that they likely took the chain tunic (kept Ringed Spider Chitin Tunic).

name: Nenet's Research
offer: I am researching a new line of mind spells and need magical acorns from an oak man - a very rare find - and a druid's wand of oak. Only druids carry the wand, not seers or sacrificers.

steps.text: Get magical acorns from an oak man far to the east, north of the main road near Salisbury Plains.
Get a druid's wand of oak from a druid in the southeast of the forest.
Return to Scholar Nenet at the Lethantis Association.

name: The Heretical Hermit
offer: Sirelian, once a student at the Lethantis Association, was discovered learning black magic from Morgana. Spurned by her, he lives as a hermit in Campacorentin Forest. Hunt him down.

steps.text: Find the hermit Sirelian somewhere in Campacorentin Forest and eliminate him.
Return to Aiellana in Adribard's Retreat.

notes: Reward per armour type inferred from item names (item pass 2 to confirm types). Sirelian's exact location not given; proof item name invented.

name: Wizard's Appeal
offer: There is a mage in Snowdonia Fortress, Cynwik the Wizard, who knows more of the druids than he admits.

steps.text: Talk to Cynwik the Wizard about the druids; ask him again and he will want you to prove your prowess.
Retrieve the essence of a cythraul from the skeletons in Llyn Barfog.
Return to Cynwik the Wizard with the essence.
Talk to Roben Fraomar upstairs in the main building of Cornwall Station about the druids in Keltoi and the Elder Gwern.
Retrieve a hunter's journal from a Cornwall hunter.
Return the journal to Roben Fraomar.
Deliver the note to Scribe Eril at the very top of Adribard's Retreat.
Descend into Keltoi Fogou and kill the Elder Gwern in the rough-walled cavern with the recluse druids.
Return to Cynwik the Wizard for your reward.

notes: Pre-1.76 version: the hunter's journal came from a Cornwall hunter (1.76 replaced this with a West Downs NPC and a tomb raider). The 'Cornwall hunter' monster name must be resolved on the server. Armsman/Paladin/Infiltrator/Sorcerer/Cabalist rewards inferred.

name: Outcast Ormgarth
offer: An outcast member of our association, Ormgarth, has been slipping deadly snakes into the beds of our members for weeks. Will you stop him?

steps.text: Find and kill Ormgarth northeast of the Ring of Sentasil. A dozen snakes attack with him.

name: Dugan's Magical Totem
offer: I am a wood carver, and if you are up for an adventure I can make you a totem. First I need a sliver of ashen wood and the eyes of Brodecia.

steps.text: Get a sliver of ashen wood from an ashen fellwood in Campacorentin Forest or Forest Sauvage.
Kill Brodecia at the ettin camp northeast of Castle Sauvage, on the south bank of the river.
Return to Dugan Advien at Caer Witrin.
Recover Dugan's carving kit from the goblin Urfgrat the Green, who walks with his cronies between the goblin camp and the ogre camp northwest of Caer Ulfwych.
Return the carving kit to Dugan.

notes: Dugan mentions several totem types (reward may have varied by class; only the Skull-shaped Totem is recorded).

name: Uncle Thulin
offer: My uncle Thulin went missing on a trip to Wearyall Hill. The guards found a chunk of metal from a forged servant where he vanished. Will you help me find him?

steps.text: Speak with Gracien Adamson in Fort Gwyntell about the [forged servant].
Return to Achae and get the [metal bit] from her.
Show the metal bit to Gracien.
Take the note and metal bits to Wearyall Village and hand the note to Elyn Badam.
Search around the Wearyall Tree for a piece of its bark.
Find a Drakoran mage and retrieve its golden orb.
Get a pair of apple fly wings from the apple flies near Wearyall Hill.
Return to Elyn in Wearyall Village with all the items.
Return to Devwy and tell Achae that her uncle is [deceased].
Search for Thulin's remains among the forged servants.
Return Thulin's remains to Achae Smith.

name: Failing Magic
offer: Our spells fail more and more, and Drakoran magic cuts right through our protections. Dory has found something, but I cannot answer his summons. If only I had someone to [go meet with Dory].

steps.text: Meet with Dory in Caer Gothwaite and tell him Eilwen sent you.
Get two metal spheres from the forged servants outside Meical's Hall.
Take the spheres to Brishene in Wearyall Village.
Recover Brishene's pendant from the Drakoran Barak in the camp east of the great tree of Wearyall Hill.
Return the pendant to Brishene.
Take Brishene's report to Dory and [choose one] of the weapons Eilwen sent.

notes: Theurgists were sent to crafted apple gatherers south of Fort Gwyntell for the spheres. Caster staff choice likely maps by class (Crystal/Ruby/Bloodstone/Sapphire); keyword-to-item mapping to confirm in item pass 2. Reported XP varies (5.7M at 26).

name: Tyngyr's Daughter
offer: My daughter is safe at Caer Witrin, but she lost some very sentimental items in the ruined keep to the south.

steps.text: Recover the first item from a ghostly knight in the church ruins on the peninsula at the southeast corner of Lake Witrin.
Recover the bracelet from a water leaper in the small pond across the road.
Take the two items to Tyna Blade at Caer Witrin, between the guards and the stable.
Return the letter to Tyngyr Blade in Adribard's Retreat.

notes: Allakhazam lists level 26 but players did it at 11-13. Bracelet holder varied (water leaper, bloody-bones, or scrag at 55k,51k). Item names not recorded.

name: Amulet of the Planes
offer: I can give you a very powerful amulet if you follow my instructions.

steps.text: Find the tomb raider Lonry Aetheoc at the ring south of the northwest guard tower in Salisbury Plains.
Return to Mairi (keep the chain).
See Fianya Walelden in Caer Ulfwych.
Get an opaque glass disc from Ciraron Webweaver, a slow spawn among the bloated spiders.
Return with the disc and chain to Fianya; she fashions an amulet.
Return to Mairi with the amulet.
Obtain the spell scroll from Borwyr the Cursed, northeast of the bridge where the Grumoz demons lair.
Take the scroll back to Mairi and pledge not to end up like Borwyr.

notes: Variations: disc from a mud golem (Avalon Marsh 16k,49k) or a cliff spider in Cornwall; Borwyr also reported in western Avalon Marsh. Done at level 18 by some (min level likely lower in the period).

name: Weakened Bonds
offer: The druids draw on the ley lines of Salisbury. Speak with Scout Dherin at the watch tower south of Castle Sauvage.

steps.text: Speak with Scout Dherin atop the watch tower just south of Castle Sauvage.
Speak with Gral Bermorn atop the tower in Caer Ulfwych.
Take the Darkenstone from one of the giant skeletons in the circle at 57k,57k.
As the last light fades, use the ley crystal at the well of the Beltaine circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Midsummer circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Lughnasadh circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Mabon circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Yule circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Imbolc circle.
Use the ley crystal at the Ostara circle.
Go to Stonehenge and use the Darkenstone.

spawn.where: small stone circle just north of the centre of Stonehenge

steps.text: Kill Archdruid Glasan.
Return to Gral Bermorn.

notes: Reward is a 'Ley Infused Belt of ...' (class-specific suffix not recorded; item pass 2). Final turn-in NPC not stated (assumed Gral Bermorn). Stonehenge circle loc to be read from the server's Stonehenge zone in Salisbury Plains.

name: Supplies for Lillian
offer: My master Lillian needs some supplies. Will you collect them?

steps.text: Get a lump of clay from the named marsh scrag Scraek in one of the two towers along the road southwest of the stable.
Get a brick of mud from the mud golems near Caer Witrin.
Get a bundle of ebony sticks from the ebony fellwoods in Campacorentin Forest.
Return the supplies to Beria at West Downs.

notes: Pre-1.76 minimum level was lower (done at 15-16); spec keeps 28 as listed, consider 15. Reward items adjusted in 1.94 (use pre-1.94 stats if item pass 2 has them).

name: The Walelden's Pendant
offer: My wife is making jewelry for a noble and requires three eyes, gathered in order.

steps.text: Talk to the fletcher's wife, Fianya Walelden, in Caer Ulfwych.
Get a crystallized leaper eye from a giant water leaper near the Avalon Marsh bridge.
Get a crystallized basilisk eye in Salisbury Plains.
Kill the rare Granddaddy Longlegs just north of Keltoi Fogou.
Return the first two eyes to Fianya.
Give the spider eye to the fletcher Eiddin Walelden.
Take the two skins to Kealan at the Lethantis Association.

name: Long Lion Fang
offer: I will make you a weapon if you bring me the materials.

steps.text: Get a bough from an elder beech in Cornwall.
Get bear sinew from the cave bears in Tepok's Mine.
Get a lion fang from the black lioness where Campacorentin Forest borders Salisbury Plains.
Bring the materials to Laurenna near the north gate of Camelot.

notes: Bough alternatives: hornbeam or black poplar fellwood in Forest Sauvage.

name: Undead Infestation
offer: The undead are all over the apple orchards. We were negotiating with Reabus Drakehide, who was to deliver information, but he never arrived. Will you help?

steps.text: Speak to Kennard Jameson, the stable master by the main gate of Caer Gothwaite, and say Reabus.
Speak to Hannah in the kitchen of Caer Gothwaite and say Reabus.
Ride to Caer Diogel; Meb is on the battlements immediately to your left as you enter.
Return to the Caer Gothwaite kitchen, where Meb appears next to Hannah.
Give the note to Toby Keeler, the stable master near the Anniogel bindstone.
Return to Meb and give him the hair and the parchment, in that order.

notes: Meb is a second spawn of the same NPC (Caer Diogel, then Caer Gothwaite kitchen for the questing player). Hair/parchment item names reconstructed.

name: Under Attack
offer: The Drakoran are attacking the forts. Speak with Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel and seek out the Drakoran commander and his lieutenants.

steps.text: Speak with Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel.
Seek out Commander Slor'vid at the campfire in the central of the three camps in the northwest of the Isle of Glass (midnight to 3 A.M.). Attack his lieutenants and he will show.
Take the commander's head to Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor. Turn in any lieutenant heads to Kimmy Glaze first!

notes: Feb 2003 patch: one head each per player. The lieutenant-head rewards appear swapped in the walkthrough (kept as written). Class weapon list incomplete; others take the Staff of Repugnance.

name: Wizard's Demand
offer: A wizard ordered magical gloves, but I am out of the special skin and my supplier is missing. Take this scrap of skin to Mathien in Snowdonia Station to identify.

steps.text: Take the scrap of skin to Mathien in Snowdonia Station.
The skin is from a frog named Worry Wort. You need a complete skin, so you may need to kill him more than once.
Return a complete skin to Yorel in Swanton Keep.

notes: Worry Wort location given only in New Frontiers coords (31k,34k); classic zone placement needed.

name: Impossible Mission
offer: Your assistance is needed to investigate the disappearance of the city of Lyonesse. The journey will be difficult and long; seek Edmond upstairs in Cornwall Station.

steps.text: Seek out Edmond upstairs in Cornwall Station.
Kill two undead farmers in Lyonesse.
Find the ruined temple and locate its guards. Approach slowly; do not fight them.
Return to Edmond in Cornwall Station.
A moor bogey called Yog has ambushed Edmond's men by the road to the Catacombs. Take care of him.
Return to Edmond.

notes: Tell the runner [Caer Witrin] in his dialog. The temple guard search area must be placed at the Lyonesse ruined temple (server coords to resolve).

name: Reports
offer: I have three reports I have not had time to follow up. Take them, and a ticket to Wearyall Village.

spawn.where: three rocks on the coast southwest of Wearyall Village

steps.text: Calikana report: go to the three rocks on the coast in Aldland southwest of Wearyall Village. The orc acolyte Calikana attacks.
Undead report: in the ghost village northeast of Wearyall toward Avalon, kill an undead ganger (or a spirit at night) for proof that Morgana controls them.

steps.where: abandoned village stable, north fork of the road into Avalon Isle along the water
steps.text: Woman in Black report: hide by the boat near the stable, watch for the woman in black, then search the stable chest for what she hid.
Return to Mistress Eveleen in Caer Gothwaite.
Give the token to Armorer Gamila and choose a weapon.

rewards.choice: weapon by type (names to confirm in item pass 2)

notes: The three reports are readable items handed out at the start (Woman in Black Report, Undead Report, Calikana Report). Weapon names are not listed.

name: Evening the Odds
offer: Collect what I need to even the odds against the orcs.

steps.text: Kill sea slimes along the beach until you have three vials.
Return the vials to Veena.
Kill inishail flies next to Veena for a vial of venom.
Return the venom to Veena.
Kill a tidal mongrel in the water between Gwyddneu and Inishail for a vial of saliva.
Return the saliva to Veena.

notes: Grants no XP. Other classes' bracers not recorded (item pass 2); fallback: casters Jeweled, others Gilded.

name: Fall of an Emperor
offer: I have long sought the mystery of the resting place of a Roman emperor in the catacombs. Will you descend into the depths to learn the name of the forgotten emperor?

steps.text: Travel to Cornwall Station and speak to Iohannes Aldar of the [catacombs].

spawn.where: chamber of cleansing, down the spiral stairs

steps.text: Locate the talkative spirit within the chamber of cleansing.
Kill Olivarius.
Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.
Kill Taras.
Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.
Kill Crotus.
Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.
Kill Amminus.
Offer his amulet in the crypt of the displaced soul.
Kill Emperor Seleucus in the chamber with the snakes.
Return to Iohannes Aldar and give him Seleucus' book of deeds.
Return to Grindan Halig and tell him the name of the Emperor.

notes: Catacombs of Cardova = the server's Catacombs of Cornwall dungeon (resolver alias). Chamber locations must be read from the dungeon on the server.

name: Spirits of the Orchard
offer: Speak with Karayan; mention that I sent you.

steps.text: Tell Karayan that Madilen sent you; he gives you a potion.
Go to Afal Dyffryn north of Wearyall and kill Nalsor.
Give the potion to Tomos, who appears when Nalsor dies, and tell him to [pour it over the seeds].
Return Brent's seeds to his orchard (they glow when you are there).
Return Lenor's seeds to her orchard.
Return Andryw's seeds to his orchard.
Return Tomos' seeds to his orchard.
Give the pouch to Karayan.
Return to Madilen for your reward.

notes: Minstrel/Armsman/Infiltrator/caster mapping inferred from the item list (Cerddorol = musical, Lladron = thieves, Lledrith = magic). Heretic Nediaun Cap skipped (post-1.65). Undead apple harvesters attack in the orchards.

name: Black Plague (Alb)
offer: A city guard fell suddenly ill, her back covered with small black oozing sores. I will need all the help I can get. Meet with Berenger Brennan.

steps.text: Meet with Berenger Brennan, who watches over Gaevin.
Speak with Gaevin Sebryn.
Take the sealed letter to Gaevin's brother Keener Woedin in Ludlow.
Bring Keener's note back to Gaevin.
Go to Dartmoor and kill a Dartmoor pony for the horse fungus.
Return to Sister Elaydith.
Go into Darkness Falls and kill Malroch the Cook.
Return to Sister Elaydith.

notes: Related item 'Stoppered Wondrous Potion' is likely given mid-quest. Malroch drop item name invented.

name: Engraved Insignia Ring -- Kill Task
offer: Kill the undead northeast of Avalon City and return their engraved insignia rings to me.

steps.text: Bring Augebert, a guard on the north side of Wearyall, engraved insignia rings.
steps.from_source: A1782: Related NPCs: Caer Caddug Knight, Decaying Marshman

notes: Kill task: XP per ring turned in (7.9M at 39-40).

name: Crushed Faith
offer: See Sir Benitt in Castle Sauvage about a glacial hammer.

steps.text: Speak with Sir Benitt in Castle Sauvage.
Seek the glacial hammer at the hill scrag camp west of Castle Myrddin.
No hammer. Return to Sir Benitt.
Kill the Snowdon Grim at the Snowdonia/Pennine pass.
Still no hammer. Return to Sir Benitt.
Kill a grave goblin in the Barrows.
Return to Sir Benitt.
Kill Dash, who appears at night south of Caer Boldiam tower 3 by the grimwoods and cockatrices.
Bring the hammer to Sister Rhigwyn.

notes: Middle targets varied (Cornish giant in Cornwall 11k,29k; gytrash in Pennine). Choice: keep it as a hammer or a polearm. Pennine Mountains / Snowdonia here are the classic frontier zones (region 1).

name: The Forest Plot
offer: The Mist Hunters need a scout's bow: kill a gytrash in the Pennines and an Arawnite shamaness in Snowdonia.

steps.text: Kill a gytrash in the Pennine Mountains (midnight to 6 A.M.).
Kill an Arawnite shamaness outside Snowdonia Fortress, at the first camp fire on the right.
Return to Rob Ria for your reward.

notes: Requires positive Mist Hunters faction (if the server has no such faction, skip the check). Arawnite camp in Snowdonia is missing on the server (see Shaman Saelonna TODO) - needs the Arawnite camp spawns.

name: Zombies, Ghosts, and Necromancers
offer: I feel our peace is disturbed: unsettled, angry spirits. Please help us; try talking to Avice Swett.

steps.text: Talk to Avice Swett, standing next to Eabae Dale in the apparition houses near Fort Gwyntell.
Talk to Eabae Dale.
Kill one of the Avalonian apparitions around the ghost houses.

steps.gives: Arawn's Rod of the Other Realm
steps.text: Talk to the Priest of Arawn in Fort Gwyntell.

steps.item: Arawn's Rod of the Other Realm
steps.text: Tell Avice Swett to [take the rod] and give it to her.
Kill the Drakoran necromancer's apprentice across the wooden bridge from the fort.
Bring the apprentice's rod of necromancy to Avice.

notes: Two starts with different rewards (cloaks vs Grym armour); which start gives which set is inferred from the comment (the 'other house' gave AF88 plate). Related item Dark Sword of Arawn not placed.

name: Secret Orders
offer: Speak to Librarian Ophus in the Academy in Camelot.

steps.text: Speak to Librarian Ophus in the Academy in Camelot.
Take his information back to Heather in Swanton Keep.
Take care of the necromancer Celain Elrich by the outer stones of the Barrows.
Return to Heather.
Tell the phrase to Librarian Ophus.
Speak to the mage Graham Mal'Toinia in the Ludlow inn.
Take his news to Heather.
Question Graham's story.
Return to Heather.
The hunter Cab'ah Bint Tabat in Llyn Barfog needs a risen ghost dragon, the Llyn Cythraul, killed in the water southeast of the merchant building.
Return to Heather.
Kill the necromancer Melechan in the bandit camp in Odin's Gate.
Return to Heather.
Answer the neutral Arawn commander's riddle on the hill northeast of Caer Sursbrooke: [knowledge] or [power].
Pass the final message on to Heather.

notes: Some classes (e.g. Cleric) had an extra step: get a journal from Tobias Warcry outside Snowdonia Fortress. Cab'ah Bint Tabat is the Llyn Barfog hunter who gives the ghost dragon step. The riddle answer chooses a better (knowledge) or lesser (power) final item - single item kept.

name: Voices of the Dead
offer: I hear voices, and I am too weak to stop them. Speak to Karayan.

steps.text: Speak to Karayan in Wearyall Village.
Arawn requires a spirit: kill a decaying marshman north of the city.
Take the spirit back to Karayan.
Kill Kelsanor in the ruins east past the lone tree on the hill. At low health he warps attackers away.
Take the essence back to Karayan.

rewards.choice: one item per weapon type (2h, longbow, shield, staves, crushing...) - names from item pass 2; Carved Bone Pin (longbow), Sanative Staff (rejuvenation focus) recorded

notes: Rewards are not class-specific. Kelsanor stays in his area (1.60 fix).

name: Prelude to War
offer: Take this note to Lieutenant Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.

steps.text: Take the note to Lieutenant Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.
Kill boggarts southwest of Caer Erasleigh to learn what they carry.
Take the runed metal bars to Sage Lissa in the tower southeast of Ludlow.
Return to Lieutenant Kuebler.
See the Albion scout in the Pennine Mountains.
Destroy the small Ellyll village over the next hill (not the main Ellyll camp).
Return to the scout.
Kill Saffron, a small named cockatrice in the trees in the valley southeast of Caer Sursbrooke.
Return to Lieutenant Kuebler.

notes: Saffron's helm is a class-dependent one-time drop. Alternative bar source: cliff crawlers east of Caer Berkstead.

name: Malignant Creatures
offer: Kill seven kinds of undead creature and bring me proof.

steps.text: Kill a phantom magi.
Kill a defiled skeleton.
Kill a headless footman.
Kill a grasping ghoul.
Kill an ebon skeleton.
Kill a corpse delver.
Kill a haunted rowan.
Return to Mordwywr, the enchanter in the largest building in Little Haven.

notes: Rechargeable gems (1.60). Scout/Infiltrator/Minstrel -> Quickening Power inferred.

name: Free the Rogue!
offer: My friend Mercal is hiding near Krondon, the ogre citadel. Rescue him.

spawn.on_whisper_area: shadowy corner by the three barrels left of the main Krondon entrance

steps.text: Go to the three barrels just left of the main Krondon entrance (a shadowy corner) and say Mercal's name.
Mercal thanks you and heads for Caer Diogel; talk to him there.
Give Mercal's documents to Arden, the instrument merchant in Caer Diogel.

notes: 1.62 version: Mercal meets the player in town (no escort). In the period game he would not appear while ogres stood near the barrels; the generator spawns him on the whisper. Mercal also needs a town spawn in Caer Diogel for the hand-over.

name: Lost Treasure
offer: Retrieve three items for me so I can recover a magical statue.

steps.text: Get an archiator hide from a Drakoran archiator just over the bridge southwest of Fort Gwyntell.
Get blue slime from a blue-green algae on the coast west of Caer Diogel.
Get apple tree sap from the lamia Larionne at the northern end of Clifton (talk if lamias are neutral, else kill her).
Use the slime.
Use the tree sap.
Use the knife with the archiator hide; an apple tree spirit appears. Talk to it.
Free the soul of the young sorceress Eralyne, a zombie at the graveyard near Caer Sidi.
Bring the statue to Ariette in the woods behind Fort Gwyntell and choose two different bracers.

notes: Two different bracers from the list. The knife can be used up to four times. Eralyne cons red at 49.

name: Ogre's Might
offer: In the Ogre Citadel, deep within, is a chamber open to the stars, and an item I need. Talk to Arden about the [star channeler].

steps.text: Talk to Arden about the [star channeler].
Kill Malefact near the entrance in the Outerworld of Krondon to obtain the map to the star channeler's chamber.
Use the map to read it.

Follow Malefact's directions through the citadel (veer left after entering; straight, right, first left; straight, left; straight to worked stone; to the end, left, right), receiving a key piece at each point.
Defeat Scurceol Hyrde, the star channeler. Deal with the nodes first; the room is very dangerous.
Return the strange orb to Master Xavier in Caer Diogel.

notes: The five path points must be placed along the real Krondon corridors (server dungeon coords). Scurceol's Belt (dex/str) is a later version; not used.

name: Orcs with Spellbooks
offer: The orcs have stolen Avalonian tomes. Help me take them back.

steps.text: Kill orc soothsayers at the orc camp northwest across the lake until you get the Avalonian tome.
Return to Veena.
Kill buzzing nuisances east of the orc camp until you get a stinger.
Return to Veena.
Kill Chieftain Toca in the largest central hut of the orc village.
Return to Veena for your reward.

notes: Requires good lamia faction (skip if the server has no faction). Armsman/caster/Reaver mapping inferred.

name: Restoring the Magic
offer: Go to Fort Gwyntell and speak with Adelon.

steps.text: Speak with Adelon on the hill outside Fort Gwyntell, right of the gate, near a small tree.
In Meical's house below the tower, get Meical's key.
On the second floor, get a metal sphere.
In the tower, give the orb to the lifeless creation and attempt to bring it to life.
Kill the Cabalist Meical when he comes to defend his creation.
Use the key to open Meical's box, and read his note.

steps.where: Orb of Power in Meical's Tower
steps.text: Stand in the middle of the broken orb in the tower and use the pendant to cleanse it.
Return to Lady Lurlei in Caer Gothwaite with the box.

notes: Reward cut off in the walkthrough (item pass 2). Pazia and Tyian are named inhabitants of Meical's house/tower (resolve on server). Meical respawns when the creation is woken again.

name: Cynewulf the Ghostwalker
notes: Wanders between the tomb raider mounds (54k,28k south of the slaver camp and 12k,45k NNE of the west tower).

name: Cheshire One Time Drop
notes: Named cat near the howling knifemen/maidens by the first lake from the keep.

name: Dai One Time Drop
notes: Pit room beyond the ant room at the very bottom of Keltoi. Chain wearers only.

name: Black Lion One Time Drop
notes: Roams with the Black Lioness on the Salisbury border.

name: Decurion One Time Drop
notes: First hallway on the left with two friends.

name: Grunge One Time Drop
notes: Named boar near a tower past Snowdonia Fortress; roams. Reportedly not dropped for clerics and casters.

name: Tusker One Time Drop
notes: Pen behind Yarley's farm, right corner; day spawn only.

name: Nasher One Time Drop
notes: Named Snowdon grim past the Arawnite camp along the Snowdonia ridge, near the lake.

name: Nogud the Smasher One Time Drop
notes: Semi-rare named hill scrag on the north side of the hill scrag camp.

name: Angau One Time Drop
notes: Rare named mountain grim.

name: Ash One Time Drop
notes: Named red demon on the mountain before the blue man, with black panthers and little goblins (old frontier loc; zone inferred from 'past Excalibur').

name: Blacktooth One Time Drop
notes: Named shadowhunter near the cyclops camp; night spawn. Only New Frontiers locs recorded.

name: Eye of Arawn One Time Drop
notes: At the Arawnite camp in the northeast of Snowdonia (server lacks the Arawnite camp - see TODO).

name: Tattooed Drakoran Skirmisher Head -- Kill Task
notes: Skirmishers at the easternmost tents of the Drakoran camp on the northwest edge of the Isle of Glass.

name: Grim Scrap -- Kill Task
notes: Faint grims are neutral, spawn 22:00-05:00 on the left cliff just before Snowdonia Fortress.

name: Dented Drakoran Marauder Helm -- Kill Task
Afanc Hatchling Tongue -- Kill Task
notes: Hatchlings in the southwest part of the lake.

name: Billious Goo Pieces -- Kill Task
notes: Allakhazam spells the monster 'billious goo'; the server's monster is 'bilious goo' (same creature, Dales of Devwy).

name: Cliff Yale Yearling Essence -- Kill Task
notes: Allakhazam: the yearlings live in the Plains of Gwyddneau (level 42-44).

name: Fell Creature Teeth -- Kill Task
notes: Ground floor of Snowdonia Fortress.

name: Drakoran Leech Bone Necklace -- Kill Task
Strange Bedfellows (Alb)
offer: Do you accept this mission from the Council? Travel to the Albion entrance of Darkness Falls and speak with the imp Mystemas.

steps.text: Travel to the Albion entrance of Darkness Falls and speak with the imp Mystemas.
Journey to southwestern Dartmoor and retrieve a granite gem from a granite giant stonebreaker.
Return to Mystemas with the gem.
Kill Princess Nahemah.
Kill Ambassador Mannam for the Prince's plans.
Return the soul stone to Mystemas.

notes: Albion version of the 1.65 Darkness Falls chain (Allakhazam entry added later, id 2040). Steps after the gem follow the Midgard version.
